"""Independent release-socket acceptance for optional direct-peer admission."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import select
import signal
import socket
import struct
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'scripts'))
import benchmark as runtime

candidate=json.loads((root/'artifacts/ip-admission-candidate.json').read_text())
directory=root/candidate['directory']
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def tcp(port,source):
    return socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1',port),timeout=3,source_address=(f'127.0.0.{source}',0))

class Client:
    def __init__(self,port,source,legacy):
        self.socket=tcp(port,source)
        try:
            subprotocol=b'' if legacy else b'Sec-WebSocket-Protocol: war.cbor.v1\r\n'
            self.socket.sendall(b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: localhost\r\nUpgrade: websocket\r\nConnection: Upgrade\r\nSec-WebSocket-Version: 13\r\nSec-WebSocket-Key: dGhlIHNhbXBsZSBub25jZQ==\r\n'+subprotocol+b'\r\n')
            header=bytearray()
            while not header.endswith(b'\r\n\r\n'):
                header+=self.exact(1)
                assert len(header)<8192
            assert header.startswith(b'HTTP/1.1 101 ')
            channel=f'i{source}'.encode()
            self.send(1 if legacy else 2,channel if legacy else bytes([0x60+len(channel)])+channel)
            opcode,welcome=self.read();assert opcode==2
            if legacy:assert len(welcome)==8
            else:assert welcome and welcome[0]>>5==0
            packet=welcome+b'ABC\x00\xff' if legacy else b'\x82'+welcome+b'\x18\x7b'
            self.send(2,packet)
            assert self.read()==(2,packet)
        except BaseException:
            self.socket.close();raise
    def exact(self,n):
        data=bytearray()
        while len(data)<n:
            part=self.socket.recv(n-len(data))
            if not part:raise EOFError('TCP retired before a complete reply')
            data+=part
        return bytes(data)
    def send(self,opcode,body):
        assert len(body)<126
        mask=b'\x91\x73\x55\x37'
        self.socket.sendall(bytes([0x80|opcode,0x80|len(body)])+mask+bytes(b^mask[i&3] for i,b in enumerate(body)))
    def read(self):
        a,b=self.exact(2);assert a&0x80 and not a&0x70 and not b&0x80
        length=b&127
        if length==126:length=struct.unpack('>H',self.exact(2))[0]
        elif length==127:length=struct.unpack('>Q',self.exact(8))[0]
        assert length<1024
        return a&15,self.exact(length)
    def close(self):
        body=b'\x03\xe8ip-admission';self.send(8,body);assert self.read()==(8,body)
        assert self.socket.recv(1)==b'';self.socket.close()

def run(legacy,limit):
    port,admin,bridge_port=runtime.free_port(),runtime.free_port(),runtime.free_port()
    env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('WAR_')}
    server_command=[str(directory/'war-relay'),'--bind',f'127.0.0.1:{port}','--admin-bind',f'127.0.0.1:{admin}',
        '--workers','4','--max-connections',str(32 if legacy else 8),'--max-connections-per-ip',str(0 if legacy else limit),
        '--handshake-timeout-secs','30']
    bridge_command=[str(directory/'war-legacy-bridge'),'--bind',f'127.0.0.1:{bridge_port}','--upstream',f'ws://127.0.0.1:{port}',
        '--max-connections','8','--max-connections-per-ip',str(limit)] if legacy else None
    processes=[];flood=[];normal=0
    with tempfile.TemporaryFile() as logs:
        try:
            processes.append(subprocess.Popen(server_command,env=env,stdout=logs,stderr=logs))
            deadline=time.monotonic()+5
            while True:
                assert processes[0].poll() is None
                try:runtime.metrics(admin);break
                except OSError:assert time.monotonic()<deadline;time.sleep(.01)
            if legacy:
                processes.append(subprocess.Popen(bridge_command,env=env,stdout=logs,stderr=logs))
                while True:
                    assert processes[-1].poll() is None
                    try:
                        warm=tcp(bridge_port,1);warm.shutdown(socket.SHUT_WR);assert warm.recv(1)==b'';warm.close();break
                    except ConnectionRefusedError:assert time.monotonic()<deadline;time.sleep(.01)
            public=bridge_port if legacy else port
            flood=[tcp(public,2) for _ in range(8)]
            closed=set();expected=6 if limit else 0;deadline=time.monotonic()+3
            while len(closed)<expected:
                assert time.monotonic()<deadline
                for stream in select.select([s for s in flood if s not in closed],[],[],.05)[0]:
                    try:assert stream.recv(1)==b''
                    except ConnectionResetError:pass
                    closed.add(stream)
            initial=runtime.metrics(admin)
            try:healthy=Client(public,3,legacy)
            except (EOFError,ConnectionResetError,BrokenPipeError):healthy=None
            assert (healthy is not None)==bool(limit)
            if healthy:healthy.close();normal+=1
            if limit:
                held=[s for s in flood if s not in closed];assert len(held)==2
                held[0].close()
                deadline=time.monotonic()+3
                while True:
                    try:replacement=Client(public,2,legacy);break
                    except (EOFError,ConnectionResetError,BrokenPipeError):assert time.monotonic()<deadline
                replacement.close();normal+=1
            for stream in flood:stream.close()
            flood=[]
            deadline=time.monotonic()+3
            while True:
                final=runtime.metrics(admin)
                if final['war_connections']==final['war_sessions']=='0':break
                assert time.monotonic()<deadline;time.sleep(.01)
            if not limit:
                healthy=Client(public,3,legacy);healthy.close();normal+=1
            while True:
                final=runtime.metrics(admin)
                if all(final[k]=='0' for k in ['war_connections','war_sessions','war_queued_bytes','war_variable_bytes','war_read_buffer_reserved_bytes','war_output_queue_capacity_bytes']):break
                assert time.monotonic()<deadline;time.sleep(.01)
            if not legacy:
                assert int(final['war_ip_rejected_total'])>=6 if limit else final['war_ip_rejected_total']=='0'
            record={'legacy':legacy,'limit':limit,'server_command':server_command,'bridge_command':bridge_command,
                'initial_metrics':initial,'final_metrics':final,'normal_closes':normal,'flood_sockets':8,
                'observed_early_rejections':len(closed),'independent_ip_admitted':bool(limit),'released_address_reused':bool(limit),'passed':True}
        finally:
            for stream in flood:stream.close()
            exits=[]
            for process in reversed(processes):
                if process.poll() is None:process.send_signal(signal.SIGTERM)
                exits.append(process.wait(timeout=5))
            assert all(code==0 for code in exits),exits
        logs.seek(0);record.update(process_exit_codes=exits,logs=logs.read().decode())
    return record
